content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text makes the point UNDERDETERMINED because a verse does not name whose body is the channel.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the text names the seed of David 'according to the flesh' without naming whose body is the channel, so the point stays open.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.","room":"'does not state a link or its contrary' — I weighed whether a verse that names the seed 'according to the flesh' but not the channel is a verse not stating the link (forbidden ground for UNDERDETERMINED) or a verse carrying two senses at once (not open).","why":"Because the judge's stated reason for UNDERDETERMINED is that the text does not name whose body is the channel, which treats a single verse's failure to state the link as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED."}
